transfer.scope: One paired family at eight known addresses; complete payload transport and programmed arithmetic, not autonomous dialogue, concealment or an independent-bit reliability estimate.
transfer.execution_time_scope: Each bar uses receiver execution time, including its load/readiness and evidence recording. Whole-family wall time also includes orchestration and is reported separately.

qwen_logic.scope: Exploratory complete eight-case panel, phase-zero starts, exact state carry, conditional reset/hold; no numerical toggle or general reliability.
Exploratory complete eight-case panel, phase-zero starts, exact state carry, conditional reset/hold; no numerical toggle or general reliability.

generated_exchange.reply_dataflow: Exact complete numerical readout was used in Bob generation prompt; semantic counterfactual not tested.

spatial_bank.selection: Random mixed patches, round-robin across occupied 128 by 128 grid regions; one random candidate per class per patch; shuffled packet order.
spatial_bank.claim_scope: Exploratory matched-patch qualification at 32 warm-up plus 128 observation updates. Both members must match in both receivers. The complete substantive exchange used the earlier eight-address bank, not this later spatial bank. Two processes repeat the same coordinates and are not independent samples of the map.

original_generator.wrapper_availability: Hash and role recorded in published upstream provenance; wrapper was not available locally and was not rerun.

qwen-shrimp.png.caption: Reproduced without modification from the earlier Qwen feedback study: a parameter scan of the period-six shrimp. This image supplies dynamical context, not a new measurement of channel reliability or memory capacity.
qwen-shrimp.png.alt_text: An earlier Qwen parameter scan with a shrimp-shaped island of repeating behavior inside irregular response regions. The image has no overlaid communication addresses. It is reproduced unchanged as background context.

pythia-spatial-map.png.caption: Reproduced without modification. The left panel shows the earlier eight-address bank used for message transport. The right panel shows the separately qualified 48-address bank. Gray crosses retain excluded candidates. The background is the earlier scan, not newly measured short-window growth. Spatial mixing does not establish secrecy.
pythia-spatial-map.png.alt_text: Two panels over the same earlier Pythia scan. The original eight addresses appear at left. At right, 48 qualified addresses are distributed as 24 locally mixed pairs, each containing a zero and a one, with rejected candidates shown as gray crosses. Circles and triangles distinguish the labels without relying only on color.

conceptual_figures.two-routes.svg: Conceptual flow only: Pythia resets for each address and classifies a fresh response; Qwen carries state through a control excursion, returns to common hold and reads the resulting state. No fabricated trajectory or claim of common mechanism.
conceptual_figures.og-card.png: Conceptual typographic headline and route labels. No numerical results or empirical geometry.
